about: Guest RAM layout of the USA StarCraft 64 cartridge as read by experiments/ares-headless/capture.cpp ('tap tick rec' writes tap.bin). Addresses are KSEG0; multi-byte values are big-endian. Each field is proven (validated by a controlled change or a cross-check in a tracked audit), candidate (read in retained states, never validated by a controlled change) or unknown. tools/parity_decode.py refuses to build a gating check from a field that is not proven. Changing an offset or a status needs a new evidence line; a new layout gets a new version.

tick_counter.evidence: S1-S3 (docs/audits/2026-11-25-parity-capture-spikes.md): advances once per game tick, also in text boxes and the pause menu; never skipped in 58,215 reads

pause_halfword.evidence: S2: 1 through both T1 opening text boxes and the pause menu; unit timers frozen exactly while it is set (355 of 355 ticks)

seconds.evidence: S2: floor(unpaused ticks / 16) over 58,213 ticks when read on the follow-up step

selector.evidence: S2: 4 in a fresh campaign mission; 4 -> 6 when the Game Speed slider moved

clock.record_rule: A tick's record is the read one step after the counter changes to it (S3: the change-step read is torn about 1.3% of the time). Unpaused ticks count ticks whose change-step read shows a zero pause halfword.

unit_table.locator: one heap block: u32 size word 0x448E0 (900 x 312) then three 0xBABEFACE guard words; rows follow; exactly one match or no table (menus)
unit_table.evidence: Nov 17 and Nov 19 census states (T10, Z1, Z8, skirmish); S1-S3: found in every in-mission read, links never bad or asymmetric in 116,437 reads
unit_table.live_rule: a row is live only while its sprite pointer (+0x0C) is nonzero; free rows keep stale bytes

prev.evidence: S3 link checks: every link is zero or a row start and symmetric

hp.evidence: Nov 19 census parse (PC CUnit layout); no controlled damage observed yet

sprite.evidence: liveness rule; census counts matched Z8 placed rows exactly

x.evidence: census: placed buildings at their CHK source x; S4 move captures: Marines move toward the ordered point

owner.evidence: census: placed rows by CHK owner; skirmish human stuck at 4 workers

order.evidence: census reads only; values not mapped to order names

shields.evidence: one read-only scan of retained states (design review); gated by type

type.evidence: census type ids matched CHK placements; S2 Marine row (type 0)

energy.evidence: one read-only scan; gated by type

build_timer.evidence: S2: Marine timer counted 360 -> 0 over 360 unpaused ticks, frozen while paused

status.evidence: S2: bit 31 clear while the Marine trained, set when complete

globals.about: tap.bin carries these bytes in guest order on every tapped read; owner index k is the k-th u32 of each array (12 players).

minerals.evidence: S4 Blood Bath captures: rises by 8 at each human worker delivery while nothing is spent, together with minerals_gathered

gas.evidence: census and static reading; no gas mined in S4

minerals_gathered.evidence: S4 Blood Bath captures: cumulative, +8 per delivery, never decreases; equals the bank rise while nothing is spent

rng.evidence: seed, draw count and state words named by static reading; not validated against a launch

unknown: sprite pool layout beyond the row pointer
human_player: resolved per scenario (see tools/sc64_parity_metrics.py SCENARIOS): T1 = the owner of the Marines and SCVs; Blood Bath = the owner of the human race's workers when the computer plays another race
